name: year
description: First calendar year of the Australian financial year projected
observations: Partition column. The report projects at ten-year intervals, so only 2022, 2032, 2042, 2052 and 2062 appear

name: financial_year
description: Australian financial year projected, written as published

name: igr_edition
description: Edition of the Intergenerational Report the projection comes from
observations: Only the 2023 edition is present. The 2021 edition published chart data but no Word bundle, so its projection tables exist only inside the PDF, and the 2015 edition published neither

name: scenario
description: Projection scenario: the baseline, or one of six sensitivity variants
observations: The six variants move one assumption at a time and are published for 2062-63 only, so earlier years carry the baseline alone

name: measure_category
description: Broad grouping of the measure: demographic, economic, fiscal or payments

name: measure
observations: The report's own row label, slugged. Not covered by the dictionary: the 47 values are plain indicator and program names that the report does not code, unlike the aggregate table's measures, whose definitions the dictionary carries

name: source_table
description: Appendix table the row was built from, comma separated
observations: A1.1 to A1.4 are the projections summary; A4.2 is the sensitivity analysis

name: value_percent_gdp
description: Value as a percentage of nominal gross domestic product

name: value_aud_per_person_real
description: Value per person in real Australian dollars of 2022-23
observations: The measurement unit is empty because the backend has no AUD unit

name: value_percent
description: Value as a percentage, for growth rates and participation rates

name: value_persons_million
observations: The measurement unit is empty because the published figure is in millions to one decimal place and rescaling it to persons would imply a precision the source does not carry

name: value_years
description: Value in years, for life expectancy at birth

name: value_births_per_woman
description: Total fertility rate, in births per woman
observations: The measurement unit is empty because the backend has no births-per-woman unit
